name: EP-13 Data Import and Data Protection (Backlog)
w: Two gaps deliberately left out of the MVP and flagged to revisit before the first paying hostel: bringing an owner's existing spreadsheets in, and residents' rights under the DPDP Act 2023.
ac: Rooms and residents import from CSV
Consent, export and erasure of resident data
out: No retention scheduler, no import from other software's formats.
dod: Both subtasks complete with RLS, integration and browser tests.

name: Plan, trial and suspension fields with admin-only writes
w: The operator needs to know who is on trial, who pays and who is suspended, and owners must never change these themselves.
ac: hostels.plan (trial, paid, free), trial_ends_at and suspension_reason
Every new hostel starts on a 90-day trial set by trigger
Users cannot write plan, trial_ends_at or suspension_reason (column grants)
A suspended hostel is skipped by the membership helpers, so its data is closed to owner and staff
out: No billing or payment collection from hostels.

name: Platform admin console with usage per hostel
w: See every hostel, its owner and how much it is used, without reading resident data.
ac: /admin lists every hostel with owner, plan, trial end, status, beds used, collected this month and last activity
Counts come from admin_hostels(), which checks the caller is a platform admin
Admins read no tenant table and cannot act inside a hostel
Anyone else gets a 404
out: No impersonation that can write data on behalf of a customer.

name: Set plan, extend trial, suspend and restore a hostel
w: Act on what the console shows: convert a trial, extend it, or suspend a non-paying hostel with a reason the owner sees.
ac: admin_set_plan requires an end date for trials
admin_set_suspended requires a reason and refuses drafts
Owners of a suspended hostel see why on /suspended; staff are told to ask their owner
Owners see a banner from 14 days before their trial ends

name: Grant platform admin from the command line
w: There is no UI to create the first admin, and there should not be.
ac: npm run admin:grant -- <email> promotes an existing account
Refuses accounts that own a hostel or are staff
Seed adds admin@demo.hostel-erp.test

name: Reminder log and reminder wording
w: Know who was reminded, when and by whom, and let each owner word the reminder.
ac: reminder_log is append-only; members insert their own sends; sender name snapshotted
last_reminders gives the latest reminder per resident
hostels.reminder_template with {name}, {hostel}, {amount}, {due_date}; unknown placeholders refused

name: Fee reminders over WhatsApp click-to-chat
w: Chasing rent is the owner's biggest time sink. Without a provider account, the app can still prepare the message and open WhatsApp.
ac: /fees/reminders lists everyone who owes rent, most overdue first, with last reminded
WhatsApp opens with the message ready (wa.me); copy is the fallback; both are logged
Dashboard overdue panel shows when each resident was last reminded
out: No automated sending; the person still presses send.

name: Payment receipts over WhatsApp
w: Residents expect a receipt when they pay.
ac: Each live payment on an invoice has a Send button with receipt text and balance left
Logged as kind receipt with the invoice

name: Automated WhatsApp, SMS or email provider
w: Scheduled reminders without anyone pressing send. Needs a provider account and, for WhatsApp, approved templates.
ac: A NotificationChannel implementation for the chosen provider
Scheduler for due and overdue reminders
Delivery status and retries recorded in reminder_log
out: Not started: blocked on choosing a provider and creating the account.

name: Staff invitation and management
w: Staff accounts were seed-only in the MVP, so no real hostel could add a warden.
ac: Owners invite by email from Settings > Staff; the invited person sets a password on /welcome
Pending invitations can be resent or cancelled
Removing staff ends access at once (deactivated profile, banned login) and keeps their name on history
Re-inviting a removed person to the same hostel restores access

name: Security deposit ledger and refunds on vacate
w: Every PG takes a deposit and settles it on move-out; there was nowhere to record it.
ac: Append-only deposit_entries: collected, deduction (with reason), refund
Held amount derived, never stored; deductions and refunds cannot exceed it
Owners void with a reason; a collection cannot be voided while refunds depend on it
Vacate dialog shows what is held; dashboard shows the hostel total

name: Online rent collection through a payment gateway
w: The biggest revenue and retention lever: residents pay by UPI or card and the payment is recorded automatically.
ac: Gateway order per invoice, webhook verified, payment recorded with reference
Refunds and failures handled
Settlement report
out: Not started: needs a Razorpay (or similar) account and KYC.

name: CSV import for rooms and residents
w: Owners arrive with spreadsheets; typing everything in was the biggest hurdle to starting.
ac: Upload, check every row with the form rules and against existing records, fix, check again, import
Copes with Excel and Sheets exports and common header spellings, Indian dates
All or nothing; owners import rooms, members import residents
ID numbers hashed before the call and never echoed back

name: Resident consent, data export and erasure (DPDP Act)
w: The product stores KYC data, so residents' rights under the DPDP Act 2023 had to exist before the first paying hostel.
ac: Consent required at registration and import, stamped by the database
Owners download everything held about a resident as JSON; logged
Owners erase personal details of settled former residents; money records kept under a pseudonym; logged
Erased records cannot be edited or reactivated
